# codebase-memory-mcp

> A preview local code-intelligence layer for coding agents. It indexes the
> current worktree into a structural graph and returns focused, reproducible
> evidence within a caller-supplied token budget. Indexing and querying remain
> local; no LLM is embedded in the server.

## Product contract

- Fresh: index metadata identifies the generation, commit, dirty fingerprint,
  and whether the result is stale.
- Trustworthy: ranked evidence carries source coordinates, origin, confidence,
  and a reason for inclusion.
- Efficient: `get_context` packs the smallest useful set of snippets and traces
  into a token budget without generating an LLM summary.
- Language tiers: core quality targets are Go, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript,
  Java, C/C++, and Rust. C#, PHP, and Kotlin static resolvers are preview.
  Other bundled Tree-sitter grammars are best-effort structural support.
- Default tools: get_context, search_graph, search_code, trace_path,
  get_code_snippet, get_architecture, detect_changes, index_status, and
  index_repository.
- Advanced graph/ADR tools and administrative tools require explicit toolset
  enablement.
- Distribution: local C binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

## Evidence

Current claims must point to a versioned benchmark artifact with pinned commits,
hardware, tool versions, raw responses, and traces. Historical results from the
66-language project study are described in
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27277 and are not guarantees for every language or
the current worktree.
